**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
  A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g., "I'm always struggling with styling standard ScrollViewers...").

  **Describe the control/feature you'd like**
  A clear and concise description of what you want to see. (e.g., "A modern expandable DataGrid").

  **Design References**
  Do you have a visual example of what you want? (Paste links to Dribbble, Pinterest, Behance, or attach screenshots here).

  **Why is this needed?**
  Describe why this control would be useful for other Avalonia developers.
